items.q: Can I buy products without installation?
items.a: Browse the catalogue and compare specifications. Send AIMS the model codes and quantities you need to request a supply quotation.
AIMS supplies, installs and supports access control and time attendance systems across the UAE. Contact the team with your site location and requirements.

items.q: Do you supply customers outside the UAE?
items.a: For delivery to the GCC or Africa, share your destination, model codes and quantities. Ask AIMS to confirm delivery arrangements and any required documents.

items.q: How do I choose a time attendance device?
items.a: Start with your preferred verification method, user capacity and connection requirements. Compare the published specifications and ask AIMS about software compatibility before ordering.

items.q: Where can I get the software?
items.a: The software links open AIMS’s current pages. Software is supplied on request; confirm licensing, compatibility and setup requirements with the team.
The Deira showroom address and directions are listed above. Call before you travel to confirm opening hours and whether the devices you want to see are available.
